reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a computer-name may not be an implementor-name (device-, feature-, switch- or code-name), is at most 30 characters and has no underscore; the reserved-word set is the 1985 one, so words reserved only later are computer-names

probes.expected: accepted: system-names intersect user-defined words and function-names (IV.4.2.2.1 SR1b); later-edition reserved words are not 1985 reserved words

probes.printed: COBOL1971 (SOURCE-COMPUTER) and COBOL1970 (OBJECT-COMPUTER) for MOVE, LENGTH, RANDOM, SUM
probes.expected: refused: a reserved word is never a system-name (IV.4.2.2.1.3); LENGTH, RANDOM, SUM never a system-name (IV.4.2.2.1 SR2b)

probes.printed: COBOL1567 31-character word exceeds the 30-character COBOL-85 maximum; COBOL2773 hyphen last; a nonnumeric literal and the all-digit 370 refused (COBOL1971/COBOL1970, with an extra COBOL3734 area-A message)
probes.expected: refused: a COBOL word is at most 30 characters, hyphen not first or last (IV.4.2.2.1, IV.4.2.2.1.2); an all-digit name is excluded by the documented implementor formation rule DOC-A.1-198

probes.printed: COBOL7624 for console (device-name, lowercase), ebcdic (code-name), C01 (feature-name), SWITCH-1 (switch-name), SYSIN, SYSOUT
probes.expected: refused at 85: computer-name, implementor-name and language-name are disjoint sets within an implementation (IV.4.2.2.1.2)

probes.printed: 85: COBOL0900 the underscore in a COBOL word requires COBOL-2002; 2023: console/ebcdic accepted, RAN
probes.expected: 85 refuses the underscore (not in the 1985 system-name character set) and implementor-name computer-names; later editions accept both

reader.requirement: At --std 85 the SOURCE-COMPUTER computer-name must be a system-name: a COBOL word of at most 30 characters from A-Z, 0-9 and hyphen (not first or last), not a 1985 reserved word nor LENGTH, RANDOM or SUM, and (the three system-name types being disjoint) not one of the implementation's implementor-names; it may coincide with a user-defined word or function-name.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses exercise implementor-name refusal (CONSOLE), later-reserved words accepted, clause shape; not the 1985 reserved words, LENGTH/RANDOM/SUM, the 30-character limit, the underscore, or function-name/data-name coincidence

reader.notes: The grammar's computerName (cobolWord or a gated word free at the edition) plus the 85-only GateComputerName implement the system-name definition of IV.4.2.2.1.2 with this implementation's documented formation rule (DOC-A.1-198: no all-digit name). Reserved words in the slot are refused by the closed-format COBOL1971 rather than a computer-name message, and a literal or digit-only name draws an extra COBOL3734; both are wording, the refusal is right.

refuter.evidence: Probe src/r2-disk.cob: SOURCE-COMPUTER. DISK. / OBJECT-COMPUTER. PRINTER. in a program whose own SELECT says ASSIGN TO DISK "r2dsk.dat" compiles and runs at --std 85 (runs/r2-disk-001, RAN). Probe src/r2-rdnames.cob: SOURCE-COMPUTER. LINE-SEQUENTIAL. / OBJECT-COMPUTER. BINARY-SEQUENTIAL. runs at 85 (RAN). DISK and PRINTER are this implementation's ASSIGN implementor-name-1 device classes (DOC-A.1-71, AssignTargetRule.DeviceClasses) and BINARY-SEQUENTIAL / LINE-SEQUENTIAL its only RECORD DELIMITER implementor-name-1 values (DOC-A.1-150, RecordDelimiterNames; every other word refused COBOL7598), so each is an implementor-name the implementation specifies. 1985 makes computer-name, implementor-name and language-name disjoint within an implementation, so none may be a computer-name. GateComputerName consults only ImplementorNames (SPECIAL-NAMES device/feature/switch) and ImplementorCodeNames, and DOC-A.1-198 lists only items 189-191 and 183-184. 1985-only reserved words were refused (r2-res85a ENTER/RERUN: COBOL0001/COBOL1970; r2-res85b SEGMENT-LIMIT/MODULES: COBOL0901). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VI.4.3.3 SR1  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.1.2  (4.2.2.1.2 System-Names)  the text is in the clause'; 'OK  §1985:VII.2.3.3 SR3 ... the text is in SR3' (implementor-name-1 content defined by the implementor); 'OK  §1985:VII.2.8.4 GR3 ... the text is in GR3'.
